description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for Notification entities, providing methods to perform database operations related to notifications, including retrieving the latest notifications for a specific user.

classes.name: NotificationRepository
classes.description: A repository interface for Notification entities, extending JpaRepository to inherit CRUD operations and defining a custom query method.

methods.name: findTop50ByUserIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc
methods.description: Retrieves the top 50 Notification entities for a specific user, ordered by creation time in descending order.
